name: Smart Endertom Control
description: Server-side (SP + MP, no client mod needed) QoL tuning: Phantom insomnia spawning (eligibility threshold, per-eligible-night spawn-chance caps and group-size caps, falling back to plain vanilla behavior once the configured tiers run out), Enderman block-griefing (independent pickup/place chance multipliers, with an extra check for a configurable list of problematic blocks), and Creeper explosion block recovery (configured blocks always drop their normal item or their own block item, bypassing explosion decay).
